item.description:
### Changed - **Claude: MCP tools are named readably.** A permission request for an MCP tool used to read like `mcp__github__create_pull_request`, on the row, the Mac notification, your phone and your watch. It now reads `github - create_pull_request (MCP)`, close to what Claude shows in the terminal. The "don't ask again" button says the same. Phones on the current app see it too.
### Fixed - **Claude: `claude purge` no longer shows up as a session.** Claude Code 2.1.288 added the command, and Perch mistook it for a running session.
